changes: Updated lifecycle-registry so TEST transcript evidence at .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/evidence/transcript-diff.md is a closed lifecycle artifact; tightened nested evidence matching so arbitrary evidence files remain out of scope; expanded process-fact regression tests; documented the policy.
usage: In TEST, record the user acceptance transcript at .koala/story/actives/<storyId>/evidence/transcript-diff.md, then run lattice/koala scope_contract_check and validate. No scope_contract_acknowledge is required for this one lifecycle evidence path.
expectedOutcome: A transcript-only TEST evidence diff should keep scope_contract_check clean, preserve reviewer scope binding freshness, and still reject arbitrary sibling evidence files.
actualTranscript: Local Lattice CLI returned Scope gate: pass for B-f3db with evidence/transcript-diff.md present; validate returned PASS with verification coverage 6/6; REVIEW concept, quality, test-coverage, and docs lanes all passed.
outcomeDiff: Expected and actual match. The only intentional behavior change is allowing the exact story-scoped evidence/transcript-diff.md lifecycle path.
limitations: Current worktree verifies with node packages/main/dist/cli.js. The globally installed koala package remains older until package/install refresh, so it can still misclassify the new transcript path before refresh.
pitfalls: A stale globally installed koala still reports the transcript as OUT_OF_SCOPE. Use the local built CLI in this worktree for this branch, or refresh the global install after merge.
